recheck.text: What legalMoves, applyMove and status do when the FEN argument is missing, not a string, malformed (empty, wrong number of ranks or squares in a rank, unknown piece letter, bad side-to-move or other field, trailing whitespace or newline) or syntactically valid but an impossible position (a side with no king or two kings, a pawn on the first or eighth rank, the side not to move already in check).

defects.title: Malformed FENs get confident wrong answers instead of an error
defects.repro: const c=require('./src/chess.js'); c.status('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR x KQkq - 0 1'); c.legalMoves('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR x KQkq - 0 1'); c.applyMove('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/9/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1','e2e4'); c.legalMoves('rnbqkbnr/ppppxppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1')
defects.observed: 'stalemate'; []; 'rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/97/8/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR b KQkq e3 0 1'; 20 moves (the 'x' is echoed into later FENs)
defects.expected: A thrown, descriptive error for a bad side-to-move field, a rank of the wrong length or an unknown piece letter

defects.title: Missing, non-string or empty FEN throws an internal TypeError with no useful message
defects.repro: const c=require('./src/chess.js'); c.legalMoves(); c.status(42); c.applyMove('', 'e2e4'); c.legalMoves('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - x 1')
defects.observed: TypeError "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'trim')"; TypeError 'fen.trim is not a function'; TypeError 'ranks[rank] is not iterable'; SyntaxError 'Cannot convert x to a BigInt'
defects.expected: An error that says the FEN is invalid (any class)
